content:
**Skeet Shooter** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Small guns gain increased accuracy and spread.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Your small guns have 45% better accuracy and spread. | 0032234F | 

Before update 60, the perk worked only with shotguns and had 3 ranks. The perk used to increase accuracy and spread.

Skeet shooting is a competitive activity where participants, using shotguns, attempt to shoot clay targets thrown into the air at high speeds.
